content: Anthropic Python SDK 1.0.0 released 2026-08-20. Critical breaking changes: (1) Python requirement raised to >=3.10 — Python 3.9 is dropped. (2) output_format deprecated → use output_config. (3) messages.parse() API updated. (4) HTTP layer moved from httpx to httpx2. The existing fdars advisor pins anthropic>=0.72.0 (0.x line) — the 0.x series (current: ~0.122.x) still works on Python 3.9 and stays available via pip install 'anthropic<1'. The 1.0 line requires Python >=3.10 matching the mcp extra constraint already applied to fdars[mcp]. For new advisor capabilities targeting Python >=3.9, keep pinning to the 0.x series.
